title: SEP IRA, Explained Simply
custom_excerpt: A big-limit, low-paperwork retirement account for the self-employed and small shops.
meta_title: SEP IRA Explained Simply | Thrifty Crew
meta_description: What a SEP IRA is, why self-employed folks love the high limits, and a real-dollar example of how much you can shelter from taxes each year.
